records.name: Parks Canada shuttle seat to Moraine Lake
records.summary: Reserved Parks Canada shuttle for one day from the Lake Louise Park and Ride to Lake Louise and Moraine Lake, with the Lake Connector. Park entry is extra.

price.quote: Adult (18 – 64 years) $ 12.75; Senior (65+ years) $ 6.00; Youth (17 and under) $ 4.00
price.note: Plus a non-refundable reservation fee of $3.50 online or $5.50 by telephone. The fees page gives no year; read during the 2026 season.

window.quote: The remaining 60% of seats are released at 8 am MDT, two days before each departure day.
window.note: Launch was Wednesday 15 April 2026 at 08:00 MDT; the date is set each year (a pattern). Seats typically sell out well ahead; a seat on the day is not recommended.

change.note: Change fee 3.50 online or 5.50 by phone; no change within 1 hour of the departure window.

cancel.note: Less the reservation and cancellation fees; none within 1 hour of the departure window.

quota.note: 1-hour departure windows from the Park and Ride; up to 10 seats per reservation.

entry.quote: A reservation is required for all Parks Canada shuttles.
entry.note: One ticket covers one day: a trip to either lake, the Lake Connector between them and the return to the Park and Ride. Free parking at the Park and Ride for reservation holders.

origin.reason: CS7 research: the product sold at this place (capture contract 2.4).

records.name: Roam Reservable Super Pass (Banff to Lake Louise and Moraine Lake)
records.summary: Roam Transit day pass from Banff with a reserved 8X round trip to Lake Louise and the Parks Canada Lake Connector to Moraine Lake. Online only, round trip only.

v.note: youth; age 18 only with high-school ID
free, but each child still needs a reservation

price.quote: Adult +19 Seniors +65 Youth 13-18* ... $30 $15 $15 Children 12 and under are free, however still require a reservation
price.note: Prices are for a same-day return; outbound and return on different dates cost 30 more per person. A 3 reservation fee per booking is non-refundable.

window.quote: Reservations for September & October (until the 12th) open at 9 a.m. MT on July 27th
window.note: 2026 batches: June opened 23 April, July 25 May, August 22 June, September and October 27 July (36 to 40 days before the month). Usually sold out for much of the summer.

cancel.note: A 25% fee more than 48 hours before departure; no refund within 48 hours; the reservation fee is never refunded.

entry.quote: This pass is valid for one day only and will expire at midnight on the date of travel.
entry.note: Moraine Lake only when the journey starts in Banff; arrive 20 minutes early or the reservation is cancelled. The Lake Connector is first come, first served.

origin.reason: PA-R-CA: the second way to reach Moraine Lake without a car (booking row moraine-private-access; D8-R proposal).
